what: While checking, five candidates were found missing from the site’s 2013–2022 data because of how party names were printed: Preudhomme (GULP, 2022 St. John), Fletcher and Whiteman (independents, 2018), Raleigh Date (2013) and Lawrence Amedé (MIC, 2013). Some rejected-ballot counts were also misread.
action: Fixed. 2013, 2018 and 2022 now match each report’s Final Summary exactly, party by party.
